user_question: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_plan.goal: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College borough boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a catalog dataset representing the State College borough boundary needed to identify intersecting census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available catalog candidate for the State College borough boundary. Do not assume the returned artifact is suitable until its metadata and spatial coverage are inspected.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundary to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce a borough boundary in EPSG:26918 so it can be used with the census tract polygons.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the retrieved borough boundary to EPSG:26918. Use the explicitly observed source CRS; do not infer or guess it.

workflow_steps.title: Identify census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Clip the census tract polygons to the borough boundary, retaining the tract attributes needed for zonal summaries.
workflow_steps.instructions: Clip the census tract layer using the reprojected State College borough boundary. Preserve the tract identifier attributes and retain all tract features that intersect the borough.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject elevation raster to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Align the elevation raster with the census tract zones for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the elevation GeoTIFF from its observed CRS to EPSG:26918, preserving elevation values and producing a raster suitable for zonal statistics.

workflow_steps.title: Compute mean elevation by intersecting tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Summarize mean DEM elevation for the census tract zones intersecting State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal statistics using the mean elevation statistic for each polygon in the intersecting tract zones. Preserve the tract identifier fields in the CSV summary.

requirements.scope: The retrieved candidate must represent the State College borough boundary and cover the requested borough area.
The retrieved borough boundary must have an explicitly identified source CRS before reprojection.
The retrieved borough boundary must be available as a vector GeoPackage or GeoJSON layer.
The census tract layer and borough boundary must both be in EPSG:26918 before clipping.
The borough boundary geometry must be valid for clipping.
The elevation raster CRS must be explicitly identified before raster reprojection.
The reprojected DEM and intersecting tract zones must have matching CRS for zonal statistics.
The intersecting tract zone geometries must be valid for zonal statistics.
